brief.title: North Point (sample)
brief.subject: A made-up story for testing the horizontal timeline

nodes.title: The great storm
nodes.desc: The old lighthouse falls in a winter storm; the harbour master's brother is lost at sea.

nodes.title: A vow at the shore
nodes.desc: The harbour master swears no ship will founder in the bay again.

nodes.title: Mara arrives
nodes.desc: Mara steps off the ferry with a sealed letter and no plan beyond reading it.

nodes.title: The letter is read
nodes.desc: The letter names an inheritance: a ruined lighthouse on the north point.

nodes.title: Tomas sails north
nodes.desc: Tomas takes the supply boat to the logging camps, chasing debts.

nodes.title: Ilse opens a school
nodes.desc: Ilse opens a schoolroom above the chandlery.

nodes.title: Trouble at the camp
nodes.desc: A fire at the camp leaves Tomas owing the foreman a season's wages.

nodes.title: An old map
nodes.desc: A pupil brings Ilse a chart showing a channel nobody uses.

nodes.title: Repairs begin
nodes.desc: Mara hires the town's carpenters to rebuild the lighthouse tower.

nodes.title: Tomas comes back
nodes.desc: Tomas returns with the foreman's men on his heels.

nodes.title: The harbour council
nodes.desc: Mara, Ilse and Tomas face the council over who owns the north point.

nodes.title: The harbour master remembers
nodes.desc: Asked about the north point, the old harbour master tells of the storm of 1810.

nodes.title: The light is lit
nodes.desc: The rebuilt lighthouse is lit for the first time; the old channel is marked.

nodes.title: A quiet winter
nodes.desc: The town settles; the ferry runs twice a week.

connections: The chart's channel is the one the light marks.
